calibrated_speed_kmh.reason: No camera calibration (homography / road-plane geometry) is configured. Real-world speed cannot be derived from pixel motion.

face_recognition.reason: InsightFace buffalo_l (SCRFD + ArcFace), detection and recognition only. Results are similarity candidates (POSSIBLE_MATCH) for human review, never identifications; accuracy falls sharply for small, blurred or turned-away faces.

fire_smoke_detection.reason: No fire/smoke detection model is installed. Color-based inference would produce unacceptable false positives.

license_plate_text.reason: Single-frame OCR without cross-frame consensus voting. Individual reads are not independently trustworthy.

person_garment_color.reason: CLIP zero-shot over fixed-ratio box slices. Pose-guided garment segmentation not yet enabled, so crops may include background.

vehicle_color.reason: CLIP zero-shot over the full vehicle box. Body-region masking and windshield exclusion not yet enabled.

vehicle_make.reason: No fine-grained vehicle make/model classifier is installed. CLIP zero-shot is not reliable for make identification at CCTV resolution.

vehicle_model.reason: No fine-grained vehicle make/model classifier is installed.

vlm_captioning.reason: General-purpose BLIP captioning: useful scene context, but not authoritative for counts, identity, colours or plates, and known to misname objects (e.g. buses as a train).
